name: The Sun – an Interactive Textbook
description: A 3D Sun from the core to the Earth, with eight textbook chapters tied to its views: interior cutaway with a standard-solar-model temperature map, fusion core, convection zone, granulation, sunspots, corona and prominence, and the solar wind spiralling out to Earth. Eight instruments as at a solar observatory – white light, Hα, He II 304 Å, Fe IX 171 Å, Fe XII 193 Å, magnetogram, Dopplergram and total eclipse – plus an 11-year cycle slider, a flare and CME, and the Sun's 5-minute oscillations made audible. Hover anywhere for live physical values; glossary popups in the text. Runs offline in the browser.
